reason: EXACT_BLOCKER: after three zero-acceptance rounds the method was materially changed from Historic England catalogue/download metadata to direct inspection of an official Planning Data BUILDING_PRESENT producer record. A previously unused verified official public no-login London Borough of Barnet listed-building-outline entity 42121158 / reference 1294762 (HENDON TOWN HALL) was processed (1 source record). The record provides authoritative MultiPolygon geometry, BUILDING_PRESENT semantics, Open Government Licence v3.0 and dated evidence, but exposes no canonical_parcel_id and no exact DEM/LIDAR tile selector. Because canonical parcel binding/spatial join is reserved to local OpenCode, the height_difference_2 family start criterion remains unsatisfied and no DEM/LIDAR source window was opened. Local OpenCode must publish a non-null height_difference_2 canonical_parcel_id bound to this or another BUILDING_PRESENT record plus parcel geometry/bbox, or an exact official DEM/LIDAR tile selector.
required_binding: parcel geometry/bbox or exact official DEM/LIDAR tile selector
